howToPay.title: How to pay with crypto
howToPay.intro: Never paid with crypto? Here is the simplest way, using Binance. It takes about 5 minutes. USDT on the TRC20 network is usually the cheapest option.

steps.title: Get USDT on Binance
steps.body: Create a Binance account and buy USDT (with a card, bank transfer or P2P). Keep it in your Spot wallet.

steps.title: Choose your plan here
steps.body: On our pricing page choose a plan and duration, select “USDT — TRC20” and click “Pay with crypto”.

steps.title: Copy the address and amount
steps.body: The payment page shows a wallet address and the exact amount to send. Keep this page open.

steps.title: Withdraw from Binance
steps.body: In Binance: Wallet → Spot → Withdraw → USDT. Paste the address and pick the SAME network shown on the payment page (TRX / TRC20).

steps.title: Send the exact amount
steps.body: Binance deducts its network fee from the amount you enter. Make sure the “Receive amount” is at least the amount on the payment page.

steps.title: Confirm and wait
steps.body: Confirm with your 2FA code. After a few minutes the payment page — and your status page here — shows “Paid” and your plan is activated automatically.

tips: Always use the network shown on the payment page. Sending on another network can lose the funds.
Send in a single transaction. If you send less, the payment shows as “Partially paid” and the plan is not activated until the rest arrives.
Invoices expire after a while. If yours expires, simply start a new payment.
Problem with a payment? Contact support with your order number.
